title: "simulation_tinyVAST"
output: html_document
date: "2025-09-29"
---

```{r}
# --- 1. LOAD LIBRARIES ---
# Ensure these libraries are installed: install.packages(c("dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyr", "tinyVAST", "fmesher", "sf"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tinyVAST)
library(fmesher)
library(sf)

# --- 2. SET SIMULATION PARAMETERS ---
set.seed(123) # for reproducible results
n_simulations <- 500 # Number of bootstrap replicates
prop_trawlable <- 0.7 # Proportion of the grid that is trawlable
sample_prop <- 0.1 # Proportion of cells sampled in each habitat type (trawlable and untrawlable)

# --- 3. DEFINE THE SIMULATION FUNCTION ---
# This function runs a single, complete simulation from world generation to estimation.
run_single_simulation <- function(sim_id) {
  
  # --- A. CREATE VIRTUAL WORLD & POPULATION ---
  grid <- expand.grid(x = 1:20, y = 1:20)
  n <- nrow(grid)
  
  # Define habitat types
  n_trawlable <- round(n * prop_trawlable)
  n_untrawlable <- n - n_trawlable
  trawlable_vals <- sample(1:5, n_trawlable, replace = TRUE)
  untrawlable_vals <- sample(-4:0, n_untrawlable, replace = TRUE)
  grid$bottom_type <- sample(c(trawlable_vals, untrawlable_vals))
  
  # Simulate fish presence and biomass
  beta <- -0.4625 # Pre-calculated beta for habitat preference - this makes fish ~4x more likely to be present in untrawlable hab (value = -4) than trawlable hab (value = 5)
  base_biomass <- 5
  ut_multiplier <- 4 # Biomass is 4x higher in untrawlable areas
  
  grid <- grid %>%
    mutate(
      prob_presence = 1 / (1 + exp(beta * bottom_type)),
      presence = rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = prob_presence),
      biomass = ifelse(presence == 1, base_biomass * ifelse(bottom_type <= 0, ut_multiplier, 1) * rlnorm(n, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 0.3), 0)
    )
  
  true_total_biomass <- sum(grid$biomass)
  
  # --- B. SIMULATE SURVEY SAMPLING ---
  trawlable_cells <- grid %>% filter(bottom_type > 0)
  untrawlable_cells <- grid %>% filter(bottom_type <= 0)
  
  trawlable_sampled <- trawlable_cells %>% sample_frac(sample_prop)
  untrawlable_sampled <- untrawlable_cells %>% sample_frac(sample_prop)
  
  # *** MODIFIED SECTION: DELTA MODEL FOR TRAWL CATCH ***
  # Trawl survey observes biomass with error using a Delta (two-part) model
  trawlable_sampled <- trawlable_sampled %>%
    mutate(
      # Part 1: Simulate the probability of encountering/catching fish if they are present
      p_encounter = ifelse(biomass > 0, 0.85, 0), # 85% chance of a non-zero catch if biomass > 0
      catch_success = rbinom(n(), 1, prob = p_encounter),
      
      # Part 2: If catch is successful, simulate the positive catch amount using a Gamma distribution
      cv = 0.25, # Coefficient of variation for positive catches
      shape = 1 / cv^2,
      scale = biomass * cv^2,
      # Ensure scale is non-zero to avoid errors in rgamma
      positive_catch_amount = ifelse(scale > 0, rgamma(n(), shape = shape, scale = scale), 0), 
      
      # Combine to get final observed biomass
      observed_biomass = catch_success * positive_catch_amount
    )
  
  # eDNA survey covers both areas - simulate eDNA conc using log-normal process 
  all_sampled_cells <- bind_rows(trawlable_sampled, untrawlable_sampled)
  alpha <- 50 # Biomass to eDNA conversion factor
  all_sampled_cells <- all_sampled_cells %>%
    mutate(eDNA_conc = rlnorm(n(), meanlog = log(alpha * biomass + 1e-3), sdlog = 0.1))

  # --- C. CALCULATE ESTIMATES ---
  
  # Model-Based (tinyVAST) estimate of biomass based on trawl survey
  # This is wrapped in tryCatch to prevent a single model failure from stopping the loop
  tinyVAST_estimate <- NA # Default to NA
  try({
    # Prepare data for model (only trawl data has an observed_biomass response)
    model_data <- trawlable_sampled %>%
      mutate(error_level = "species_A")
      
    # Create spatial mesh
    mesh <- fm_mesh_2d(grid[, c('x', 'y')], cutoff = 2.0, max.edge = c(5, 20))
    
    # define distribution 
    Family = list("species_A" = tweedie(link="log"))
    
    # define formula 
    formula = observed_biomass ~ 1
    
    # Fit the spatial model
    fit <- tinyVAST(
      data = model_data,
      formula = formula,
      spatial_domain = mesh,
      family = Family,
      space_columns = c("x", "y"),
      distribution_column = "error_level",
      control = tinyVASTcontrol(silent = TRUE) # Suppress console output
    )
    
    # Create grid for prediction over the entire area
    pred_grid <- grid %>%
      mutate(species = "species_A",
         error_level = "species_A", 
         area = 1) 

# Predict expected biomass
pred_out <- predict(fit,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  #type = "response",  # "response" gives back biomass scale, not link scale
  what = "p_g",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

    # Add predictions to grid
    pred_grid$predicted_biomass <- pred_out$fit
    pred_grid$predicted_biomass_se <- pred_out$se.fit
      
    # Integrate predictions to get total biomass index
    total_biomass_index <- integrate_output(fit,
                                            newdata = pred_grid,
                                            area = pred_grid$area,
                                            bias.correct=FALSE,
                                            apply.epsilon=FALSE)
    
    tinyVAST_estimate <- total_biomass_index[1]
}, silent = TRUE)
  
  # Save untrawlable to trawlable DNA ratio
  eDNA_summary <- all_sampled_cells %>%
    mutate(class = ifelse(bottom_type > 0, "trawlable", "untrawlable")) %>%
    group_by(class) %>%
    summarise(mean_eDNA = mean(eDNA_conc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')
  
  eDNA_ratio <- (eDNA_summary$mean_eDNA[eDNA_summary$class == "untrawlable"] / 
                 eDNA_summary$mean_eDNA[eDNA_summary$class == "trawlable"])
  
  # Calculate estimated biomass that incorportes DNA ratio 
  prop_untrawlable <- 1 - prop_trawlable
  biomass_from_trawlable <- tinyVAST_estimate * prop_trawlable
  biomass_from_untrawlable <- tinyVAST_estimate * eDNA_ratio * prop_untrawlable
  trawl_edna_estimate <- biomass_from_trawlable + biomass_from_untrawlable
  
  # --- D. RETURN RESULTS ---
  return(data.frame(
    sim_id = sim_id,
    true_biomass = true_total_biomass,
    estimated_biomass = tinyVAST_estimate,
    DNA_ratio = eDNA_ratio,
    adjusted_biomass = trawl_edna_estimate
  ))
}

# --- 4. RUN THE BOOTSTRAP SIMULATION ---
results_list <- lapply(1:n_simulations, run_single_simulation)
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)

# --- 5. PROCESS AND VISUALIZE RESULTS ---
# Reshape data for plotting and analysis
results_long <- results_df %>%
  select(!DNA_ratio) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(estimated_biomass, adjusted_biomass),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) %>%
  na.omit() # Remove any failed tinyVAST runs

# Calculate summary statistics and 95% confidence intervals
summary_stats <- results_long %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    median_estimate = median(estimate),
    lower_95_ci = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    upper_95_ci = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

mean_true_biomass <- mean(results_df$true_biomass)
observed_biomass <- mean(results_df$estimated_biomass)
adjusted_biomass <- mean(results_df$adjusted_biomass)


# Plot the distributions of the estimates
plot1 <- ggplot(results_long, aes(x = estimate, fill = method)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_true_biomass), color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = observed_biomass), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = adjusted_biomass), color = "#7570b3", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("estimated_biomass" = "#d95f02", "adjusted_biomass" = "#7570b3"),
    labels = c("estimated_biomass" = "trawl-only", "adjusted_biomass" = "eDNA-adjusted")
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = mean_true_biomass, y = 0, label = "Mean True\nBiomass", vjust = -0.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Biomass Estimates",
    subtitle = paste0(n_simulations, " simulations | ", prop_trawlable * 100, "% Trawlable Habitat | ", sample_prop * 100, "% Sample Intensity"),
    x = "Estimated Total Biomass",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Biomass Estimation Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

plot1
```


```{r}
ggsave("../figures/estimated_biomass.png", plot1, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
